scientific_integrity: Finite exhaustive checks corroborate finite identities only; universal conclusions rely on the supplied proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary first-order logic of ternary proper-coloured successor paths/cycles, with either unary named colours or the same-colour equivalence relation; no full order, arithmetic, counting or monadic second-order quantifiers. No claim for unnamed palettes of size four or larger. Classical local-testability, Hanf locality and Markov mixing are prior results; historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Palette anonymity changes the complete first-order limit spectrum of proper ternary paths
